name: Ding Hanfei
summary: I received my B.Eng. degree in Computer Science from Harbin Engineering University, where I worked under the supervision of Prof. Rongsheng Li. Currently, I am pursuing my M.S. degree at the School of Information Science and Technology (SIST), ShanghaiTech University. My academic training is grounded in mathematics and computer science, with 90+ scores in all mathematics courses and 27 core required courses.
